_comment: Cline MCP descriptor (ADR-0051) — MANUAL FALLBACK ONLY. The PRIMARY wiring is the installer's merge of this server into ~/.cline/data/settings/cline_mcp_settings.json (the global map Cline actually reads; cline mcp manages it). Cline expands NO ${VAR} templates, so the interpreter form (/bin/bash + absolute launcher path) is used — the ADR-0042 failure-class closure. Do not run BOTH layers deliberately for the same server name. Env block is kept in strict lockstep with .mcp.json (scripts/check_mcp_env_parity.py); SKILL_SERVER_RECORDS is omitted here deliberately (the engine's Path.home() default resolves the same directory without a machine-pinned literal).
